comment: The contract-suite coverage ratchet baseline for tools/scripts/check-checker-contracts.mjs (`yarn checker-contracts:check`). Every entry names a tools/scripts/check-*.mjs checker that carries no sibling check-*.test.mjs contract suite proving it fails on the drift its header claims to catch (ADR 0085; PRD #772, slice #775). The list can only shrink as later slices add a suite for one of these checkers. A checker present here that gains a suite fails the check as stale — remove it in the same change that adds the suite. A checker found on the tree with no suite and no entry here fails the check as new, untracked debt. Deliberately no written-reason opt-out: a per-checker "not worth testing" judgment call is exactly the discretion this baseline exists to remove.
